title: Oil in water
summary: Explore related instruments for oil in water measurement.

products.name: IG3000MP-X Multiparameter Water Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Build a water monitoring system around interchangeable digital probes for parameters such as pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and turbidity. Probe connections and stored calibration data support field replacement, while an automatic cleaning arrangement helps limit surface deposits.

products.name: IG30OL Oil-in-Water Sensor
products.shortDescription: Ultraviolet fluorescence detects oil in water for applications including petrochemical wastewater and oilfield reinjection monitoring. Optical filtering and a self-cleaning arrangement help manage measurement interference and deposits, while digital communication connects the probe to monitoring systems.
